svg.title: louis-agent.core.telemetry: a host's telemetry, step by step

g.text: louis-agent.core.telemetry: a host's telemetry, step by step
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: With a collector's address set, the logs and the traces go to it, the collector's own
traffic left out; without one the host pays nothing. At the end, or at a crash, what
is held is sent, three seconds at most.
